description: Probabilistic programming in Python: Bayesian modeling and inference with MCMC and variational methods, built on PyTensor.
rules: Use `import pymc as pm`. PyMC 3 (`import pymc3`), Theano and Aesara are obsolete; the tensor backend is PyTensor (`import pytensor.tensor as pt`).
Use `pm.Data` for data containers and `pm.set_data` to swap values. `pm.MutableData` and `pm.ConstantData` were removed.
`pm.sample` returns an `xarray.DataTree`; use ArviZ 1.x (`import arviz as az`, or `pymc.stats` / `pymc.plots`) for diagnostics and plots.
Label dimensions with `coords` on `pm.Model` and `dims` on variables instead of bare `shape` tuples.
